thread:
maria: Hey team — need a slimline benchmark carousel + webinar hero for the upcoming launch. Goals: show latency vs cost waterfall, three microtiles (latency, cost, reliability), and a compact hero GIF for email + webinar pages. Must be brand-compliant and accessible (WCAG AA). Sizes: carousel cards 1200x630, hero 1280x720, social square 1080x1080. Deliverables: Figma file + export PNGs + Lottie (<=200KB). Include EN/FR/DE text variants and a version without metric overlays for regional legal.

kevin: Got it. Quick q: do we have approved copy for the three tiles? Also waterfall style — stacked bars or sparkline reveal? I lean stacked for clarity.

sasha: Copy drafts in the thread — short bullets we like for each tile. Use the phrase "inference economics" instead of raw "cost per token". Call out Dedicated capacity as an option. Minimal CTA: "See benchmark →"

oliver: I'll own delivery. Timeline: initial comps by Wed EOD, internal review Thu morning, final assets by next Tue. Who's owner for legal review?

maria: Legal is @julia-legal. Also require brand compliance check: export design tokens, no 3rd-party logos on hero, and color contrast must meet 4.5:1 (dark purple on gradient fails).

kevin: Notes: will use hero gradient from token set, build text overlay with auto-fade. Mockup link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/slimline-bench-carousel (see pages: /Frames/Carousel + /Pages/Hero). Will include a Lottie microinteraction for the waterfall reveal and a non-animated fallback PNG. File layers will be named color/typography/components for easy export.

sasha: For the webinar landing we need two headline variants to A/B: A) "Ship faster, pay less" B) "Predictable latency, lower cost" — please design two hero variants. Also add a slide-deck cover (1920x1080) that matches visual language.

kevin: Roger. For localization, would you prefer translations embedded in the same Figma file (separate pages) or distinct files? Preference: same file with one page per language to keep handoff tidy.

oliver: For exports, propose naming scheme: SI_bench_carousel_en_v1.png, SI_bench_carousel_fr_v1.png, SI_hero_lottie_v1.json. CDN-ready sizes: 1200x630@1x and 600x315@2x (retina). Also include slide deck exports PDF + PNG cover.

maria: Can the waterfall include annotated unit economics (tokens/sec and cost lines) but also provide a "clean" variant for sales decks? Yes — need both.

kevin: Added a design checklist in Figma comments: tokens export, color-contrast plugin run, Lottie size check, and layer naming standard. Tagging @maria for copy final and @sasha for CTA phrasing.

artbot: Export job queued — will post generated assets to #design-exports channel once ready.

oliver: I'll coordinate with localization for FR/DE copy and loop in julia-legal for embargoed partner mentions.

maria: Thanks everyone — pulling this into the launch timeline. Ping here if any timeline slips or if we need alternate assets (AMP email safe, low-bandwidth GIF). :rocket:
